{"notes": "Visit 4 (4:00 of 10:00). Still provisional. I can't see who placed what, so I'm going on what I heard and the picture.

Priya: Her 3:15 private update (nose holding, top line connected, joining into the tail crossing) matches the picture. The top line is dark from the start to the crossing at about x=21. Her earlier commitment to check the nose and lay a connect herself looks kept. She was quiet in the open channel this visit. Still unseen: her inspecting the tail and bottom. Check that she verifies the full fall.

Tom: His claims match the picture. The nose is live and the top line is dark. The crossing and upper tail are now dark out to about x=25, y=8.5, which is where his hands are. He communicated clearly and took ownership when Leo handed him the crossing. Pale fragments remain at the tail tip (x=22-26, y=6-8). Next: does he finish the tip and test the fall?

Leo: Honest about clipping his own join, and he reported his fall count (69/182). The bottom line now looks dark through x=14-16 and out to the tail at x=22. His 3:30 diagnosis of the crossing was correct and he delegated it well. Stray pale pieces remain near x=13.5-14.5, y=12-13.5, and the pale lower-left run from the start (x=4-9, y=11-14) is still disconnected. I can't tell whether he or Maya owns those.

Maya: She said nothing this visit. Her hands sit in the crossing area. The bottom join appears closed, but I can't credit her with it. Ask her directly what she did, and ask about the unexplained red mark.

Team: The fall should now reach most of the body and the tail. The remaining risks are the pale leftovers and an untested full run."}
